definition: Assets Under Management: the total market value of the investments managed by a scheme or AMC.
An index against which a scheme's performance is compared, such as the NIFTY 50 TRI.
Consolidated Account Statement: a single statement of all your mutual fund holdings across AMCs, issued by CAMS / KFintech / depositories.
Equity Linked Savings Scheme: an equity fund with a three-year lock-in that is eligible for Section 80C deduction in the old tax regime.
A charge deducted from redemption proceeds if units are redeemed before a specified period.
The annual percentage of a scheme's assets charged to cover management, distribution and operating expenses.
An account number allotted by an AMC to an investor; a folio can hold units of several schemes of the same AMC.
Know Your Customer: the one-time identity and address verification required before investing.
Net Asset Value: the per-unit market value of a scheme's assets after expenses, declared every business day.
The plan of a scheme bought through a distributor; its expense ratio includes the distributor's commission.
SEBI's six-level scale (Low to Very High) showing the risk of a scheme's portfolio.
Systematic Investment Plan: investing a fixed amount in a scheme at regular intervals.
Systematic Transfer Plan: transferring a fixed amount at regular intervals from one scheme to another scheme of the same AMC.
Systematic Withdrawal Plan: redeeming a fixed amount from a scheme at regular intervals.
Extended Internal Rate of Return: an annualised return that accounts for the timing of each investment and withdrawal.
